name: final_sudoku_benchmark
description: A dataset/benchmark of Sudoku puzzles and solutions intended to evaluate models' ability to perform combinatorial constraint solving and stepwise logical reasoning. It measures whether a model can produce a correct completed Sudoku grid from a partial board and handle puzzle-solving strategies rather than relying on memorized patterns.
reputation: Niche benchmark used in research on symbolic reasoning and puzzle solving; not widely used outside that community.
